about: Atomic jobs a camera-app feature can do. Every feature (GlassCam's and each reference app's) is tagged with 1 or 2 of these. A purpose set is a grouping of facets, so purpose sets are scored without re-tagging.

facets.compose: frame the shot: zoom, grid, level/horizon, aspect ratio, overlays that help composition
facets.lens: choose the camera/lens: front/back switch, physical or secondary sensor, wide/tele
facets.trigger: take the shot: shutter, self-timer, touch/volume-key capture, shutter sound, remote
facets.mode: pick a capture mode: photo, video, portrait, night, panorama, pro... (the mode switcher itself)
facets.exposure_manual: set exposure by hand: ISO, shutter speed, aperture, EV compensation
facets.exposure_auto: steer automatic exposure: AE lock, metering, AE mode, ISO/shutter limits, anti-banding, scene modes, flash
facets.exposure_feedback: see whether exposure is right: histogram, zebras/clipping, exposure readouts
facets.focus: control or assist focus: focus modes, manual focus, tap to focus, peaking, magnify-on-focus, PDAF
facets.colour: white balance and colour: WB modes/Kelvin, colour effects, saturation, colour correction
facets.processing: how the image is processed: noise reduction, sharpening, edge, contrast/brightness, tone curve/mapping, lens shading, distortion, hot pixel, HDR/dynamic processing
facets.output: what file comes out: format (JPEG/RAW/DNG/HEIF), size/resolution, quality, DNG profile/matrix/opcodes, bit depth
facets.multishot: several frames for one result: burst, exposure/focus bracketing, focus stacking, HDR merge, night stacking, MFNR
facets.time: capture over time: interval/timelapse, long sequences, duration
facets.video: video recording settings: profile/resolution/fps/bitrate, codec, video HDR, slow motion, video stabilisation
facets.audio: sound for video: audio source, levels, mic choice
facets.stabilise: image stabilisation for stills: OIS, EIS/DIS
facets.review: look at what was taken: gallery, viewer, info/EXIF panel, play video
facets.manage: keep and move files: storage location, naming, delete, share, convert (e.g. RAW to DNG), export
facets.metadata: what is written into the file besides pixels: location/GPS, EXIF fields, copyright
facets.device: make the app work on this phone: camera API choice, feature detection, capture templates, vendor/legacy toggles, orientation fixes, debug dumps
facets.app: how the app itself behaves or looks: theme, UI hiding, help overlay, preview rendering mode, night overlay, update checks, language
